description: Write E2E tests for the Coach Portal in demo mode (F9-F15 from TEST_FLOWS.md). All tests use ?demo=true to bypass auth. Tests verify demo data renders correctly, nav links work, and page elements are visible.
steps: Create `tests/e2e/coach-portal.spec.ts` with imports from '@playwright/test' and config from '../../site.config'

F9 - Coach Dashboard tests (`/coach?demo=true`): Assert sidebar shows config.brand.name. Assert sidebar shows config.coach.firstName. Assert sidebar shows config.coach.title. Assert dashboard shows stat cards. Assert pending check-in cards show client names (from demo data: 'Alex Rivera', 'Jordan Smith'). Assert active clients list shows names and goals.

F10 - Coach Leads tests (`/coach/leads?demo=true`): Assert page loads without errors. Assert stats cards render (look for headings or stat values). Assert filter tabs are present (All, New, Contacted, Converted).
F11 - Coach Clients tests (`/coach/clients?demo=true`): Assert page loads. Assert 'My Clients' and 'Find & Add' tabs render. Assert an add client mechanism exists (button or UI element).
F12 - Coach Diet Plans tests (`/coach/plans?demo=true`): Assert page loads. Assert 'New Plan' button/link exists and points to /coach/plans/create?demo=true.
F13 - Coach Workouts tests (`/coach/workouts?demo=true`): Assert page loads. Assert 'New Workout' button/link exists and points to /coach/workouts/create?demo=true.
F14 - Coach Check-ins tests (`/coach/check-ins?demo=true`): Assert page loads without errors (may show empty state).
F15 - Coach Settings tests (`/coach/settings?demo=true`): Assert page loads with a profile form. Assert name and email fields are present and editable. Assert 'Save Changes' button is present.
Ensure all navigation links within demo mode include ?demo=true suffix (verify sidebar links include demo param)
acceptance_criteria: tests/e2e/coach-portal.spec.ts exists with test cases for F9-F15
Coach dashboard test asserts demo data values (4 active clients, pending check-in client names)
All sidebar navigation links are verified to include ?demo=true
Config values (brand name, coach name, title) are imported from site.config.ts
All tests pass with `npm run test:e2e`
verification: Run `npx playwright test tests/e2e/coach-portal.spec.ts` and confirm all tests pass
Run `npm run build` and confirm no TypeScript errors
findings: 1. The desktop sidebar (aside element) must be targeted explicitly for brand/coach assertions because the mobile header has the same content but is hidden at desktop viewport (1280px). 2. The settings ProfileTab, check-ins page, clients list, plans list, and workouts list all require a real user for data loading. In demo mode without auth, these show loading spinners for the data sections. Only the page headings, tabs, and action buttons render. 3. The leads page works without user because getLeads() is called unconditionally and returns empty array on DB connection failure. 4. Only the dashboard page (/coach) has full demo data (4 clients, pending check-ins). 5. Sidebar nav links correctly append ?demo=true via the useDemoSuffix hook. 6. Plans and Workouts 'New' links do NOT include ?demo=true since they are hardcoded hrefs in those pages. 7. All 22 tests pass in ~22s.
